// diagnostic

E2403

Field-pun name `{name}` is not in scope (or is not a field of `{type}`).

What

Field-pun name `{name}` is not in scope (or is not a field of `{type}`).

Why

`Type { name }` is shorthand for `Type { name: name }` — it reads the local variable `name` and assigns it to the field of the same name. If no such local exists, or if `Type` has no field by that name, the shorthand is ambiguous.

Fix

Introduce a local `name :: …;` before the struct literal, or write the long form `Type { field_name: value }`.
